correctness.rationale: The forward walk recursion counts all path homomorphisms, including W_0=n. Cayley–Hamilton on the block diagonal of the two adjacency matrices makes the first 2n entries conclusive at equal order. An independently written rooted-multiset generator covers every rooted tree by its multiset of child trees and deduplicates free trees by the least rooted code over all possible roots. Replay with python3 /workspace/audit_evidence/walktrees.py gave no collisions at orders 1–11 and 550 profiles for 551 order-12 trees, with exactly the displayed pair in the repeated class. The independent computation checked the pair's first 12 entries, matching polynomial and rational generating function. The complement determinant lemma expresses the complement polynomial in terms of the adjacency polynomial and the signed walk resolvent; conversely the two polynomials recover that resolvent. The only repeated profile in the range has a common adjacency polynomial, so the equivalence with generalized spectra follows. This is an exact finite computational check, not formal verification.
